name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: Marshal Haggard sends you back to Darkshire with a page he cannot read. Tavernkeep Smitts may know the hand that wrote it.

sections.title: A Lead from the Marshal
sections.body: Marshal Haggard cannot read the faded writing on the torn journal page you recovered from his chest in Elwynn Forest. His eyesight is failing. The retired commander remembers serving with the Stormwind Guard and spending evenings at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. The trail leads back across the river, so he sends you to Tavernkeep Smitts. Years behind the bar have made Smitts a keeper of local history and rumors.

sections.title: Return to the Scarlet Raven
sections.body: You cross Duskwood's gloomy woods and show the faded page to Smitts behind the counter. He warms at the name of his old acquaintance Haggard, though he laments the veteran's fading health. Then Smitts sees the parchment, and alarm replaces his easygoing manner. He knows the distinctive handwriting without doubt, bringing the search closer to the truth of Stalvan's madness.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Haggard send me back to Darkshire?
faq.answer: Marshal Haggard is aging and nearly blind, so he cannot examine the recovered journal page. He remembers Tavernkeep Smitts as an expert on local lore when Haggard served with the Stormwind Guard, and sends you to have Smitts identify the script.
Tavernkeep Smitts tends the bar inside the Scarlet Raven Tavern, on the eastern side of Darkshire in Duskwood.

faq.q: What item do you carry to Tavernkeep Smitts?
faq.answer: You carry a Faded Journal Page, an excerpt from Stalvan Mistmantle's lost journal, found secured inside Marshal Haggard's footlocker.

faq.q: Does Tavernkeep Smitts recognize the handwriting?
faq.answer: Yes. Smitts recognizes the handwriting as soon as he looks at the faded page, and his alarm gives the search for Stalvan its next lead.

faq.q: How does Smitts know Marshal Haggard?
faq.answer: Smitts hosted Haggard years ago, when Haggard led Stormwind Guard patrols into Duskwood and visited the Scarlet Raven Tavern for drinks.

faq.q: What comes next in the search for Stalvan?
faq.answer: Take the faded journal page to Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern and follow the lead he gives you.

angles.text: As an Alliance defender, you see bonds between former Stormwind guardsmen and community keepers across the Kingdom of Stormwind.
As a human, you see how tragedies in Elwynn and Darkshire remain part of the settlements' memories.
